<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="voice-enrollment">
<h1>Voice enrollment</h1>
<p>PyKokoro exposes two distinct enrollment engines through
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">KokoroSynthesizer.enroll_voice()</span></code>. Inno creates a normal static Kokoro voice pack from
reference audio only. AkinVox creates a transcript-conditioned <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReferenceVoice</span></code> for its
cloning model. These outputs have separate formats and synthesis paths.</p>
<section id="inno-voice-tuning">
<h2>Inno voice tuning</h2>
<p>Inno v0.2 is a zero-shot voice tuner, not a strong identity cloner. It requires
reference audio but no transcript, and returns a standard <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[510,</span> <span class="pre">1,</span> <span class="pre">256]</span></code>
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">KokoroVoicePack</span></code> usable immediately with ordinary static Kokoro synthesis:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pykokoro</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">KokoroSynthesizer</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">KokoroVoicePack</span>

<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">KokoroSynthesizer</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">synthesizer</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">pack</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">synthesizer</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">enroll_voice</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;reference.wav&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">engine</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;inno&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">pack</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">save</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;speaker.npz&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">rendered</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">synthesizer</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">synthesize_text</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;New words in the tuned voice.&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">pack</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">rendered</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">save_wav</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;tuned.wav&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">reloaded</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">KokoroVoicePack</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;speaker.npz&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The default engine is Inno, so omit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">reference_text</span></code>. Supplying a transcript to Inno is
an error. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">InnoEnrollmentOptions(fmax=...)</span></code> can forward the supported <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">fmax</span></code> tuning
option. The reference audio is read, downmixed to finite mono float32, and passed with
its original sample rate. No raw audio is stored in the voice pack.</p>
<p>Enrollment requires a model whose runtime metadata advertises the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">inno-v0.2</span></code> enroller.
The default selection is Kokoro v1.0. For an explicitly selected model, enrollment is
rejected unless that model advertises a compatible Inno capability. Inspect this
metadata without loading model weights:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pykokoro</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">discover_models</span>

<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">model</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">discover_models</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">offline</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">models</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">enroller</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">model</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">voice_enrollers</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">model</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">model_id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">enroller</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">enroller</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">min_seconds</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">enroller</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max_seconds</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Enroller metadata includes transcript requirements, supported reference duration, and
output format. The installed OnnxVoice distribution must implement the advertised
enrollment contract. PyKokoro does not depend on the Inno source package, PyTorch,
torchaudio, or Transformers.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">KokoroVoicePack.save()</span></code> writes a versioned, pickle-free NPZ archive with the style
data, format, base-model, engine, metadata, and fingerprint. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">KokoroVoicePack.load()</span></code>
validates the archive and fingerprint. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">KokoroVoicePack.from_array()</span></code> imports a plain
compatible NumPy array. A pack is not a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReferenceVoice</span></code>, and the two formats are not
interchangeable.</p>
<p>Generated packs have no catalog voice calibration. Voice-level mode <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">off</span></code> and an
explicit gain override are supported. Automatic named-voice calibration is unavailable.
Dynamic-pack blending and legacy <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.pt</span></code> import are not provided.</p>
</section>
<section id="akinvox-reference-cloning">
<h2>AkinVox reference cloning</h2>
<p>AkinVox requires reference audio and its exact transcript. Select it explicitly. The
result is a model-bound <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReferenceVoice</span></code> state, not a static voice pack:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pykokoro</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">KokoroSynthesizer</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ReferenceVoice</span>

<span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">KokoroSynthesizer</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">synthesizer</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">voice</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">synthesizer</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">enroll_voice</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;reference.wav&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;The exact words spoken in the reference.&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">engine</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;akinvox&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">name</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;speaker&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">save</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;speaker-reference.npz&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">reusable</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ReferenceVoice</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;speaker-reference.npz&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">rendered</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">synthesizer</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">synthesize_text</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;New words with reference conditioning.&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">voice</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">reusable</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">rendered</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">save_wav</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;cloned.wav&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The maintained <a class="reference download internal" download="" href="../_downloads/2209e3dd1cadddf62fac95b0650337e7/reference_voice.py"><span class="xref download myst"><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">reference_voice.py</span></code> example</span></a> accepts a
reference-audio path, its exact transcript, and target text:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>examples/reference_voice.py<span class="w"> </span>reference.wav<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="s2">&quot;The exact words spoken in the reference.&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="s2">&quot;New words spoken with the enrolled voice.&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>AkinVox enrollment or synthesis may provision the cloning model through OnnxVoice. Reuse
a saved state with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReferenceVoice.load()</span></code>; reference audio is not needed again.</p>
<section id="reference-requirements-and-limits">
<h3>Reference requirements and limits</h3>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Version 1 supports English only. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en-us</span></code> for enrollment and synthesis.</p></li>
<li><p>Reference audio must be 3 to 30 seconds long, mono or multichannel, and supplied as a
WAV/file path or NumPy waveform with an explicit sample rate.</p></li>
<li><p>Use a clean, intelligible recording of one speaker. Avoid background speech, music,
strong reverberation, silence, and clipping.</p></li>
<li><p>Audio is downmixed to mono and resampled with SoXR high-quality mode. The parity test
against the upstream resampler checks relative RMS error below <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">5e-4</span></code> and maximum
absolute error below <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">3e-4</span></code> on its deterministic test signal.</p></li>
<li><p>Supply the exact words spoken in the reference. The transcript is phonemized by the
English frontend to prepare enrollment tokens; it is not inferred by ASR.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReferenceVoice</span></code> is bound to its cloning model ID and model fingerprint. A state
cannot be used with a different model build. Keep the saved state when reusing the
same model.</p></li>
<li><p>Reference synthesis currently requires <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">GenerationConfig.speed</span> <span class="pre">==</span> <span class="pre">1.0</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p>Automatic static-voice calibration is unavailable for a reference voice. Voice-level
mode <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">off</span></code> and an explicit gain override are supported.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
</section>
<section id="saved-state-and-privacy">
<h2>Saved state and privacy</h2>
<p>A <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ReferenceVoice</span></code> NPZ stores model-bound conditioning tensors, their fingerprint, and
optional SHA-256 metadata. It does not contain the original audio or transcript. A
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">KokoroVoicePack</span></code> stores only a normal static Kokoro style and metadata, not its source
audio. Conditioning state is derived from a person’s voice and should be handled as
sensitive data. Protect and share it only with the speaker’s permission. You must have
permission to use reference voices for synthesis.</p>
<p>The runtime uses OnnxVoice and ONNX Runtime. PyKokoro does not require PyTorch,
torchaudio, Transformers, or the AkinVox Python package for these features. Reference
audio and transcript content are not written into synthesis traces by default.</p>
<p>See the <a class="reference internal" href="../api_reference/"><span class="std std-doc">API reference</span></a> for public enrollment types and
<a class="reference internal" href="../languages/"><span class="std std-doc">model discovery</span></a> for runtime capability metadata.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
